The '''Besnia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. It was connected by the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] to the [[Herzob system/Legends|Herzob]] and [[Koensayr system/Legends|Koensayr systems]],<ref name="TEA" /> and was the origin point of [[Besnian sausage]].<ref name="Taster">{{StoryCite|story=Taster's Choice: The Tale of Jabba's Chef|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Besnian sausage]]|system=Besnia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Besnia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square N-12.<ref name="TEA" />
